core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
qualifier: salivary gland and pancreatic duct epithelium
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in salivary and pancreatic branching
rationale: All members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, branching and epithelial maturation in developing organs; the salivary gland and pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineage members distinguish it from the mammary/prostate, kidney and lung neighbours.

name: Positive regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and VEGF production
rationale: Members all promote angiogenic sprouting, endothelial proliferation/migration and VEGF production; neighbours instead hold negative regulation of endothelial growth or VEGFR2/Tie receptor signaling.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members concern estrogen/estradiol responses, estrogen receptor-dependent transcription and progesterone receptor signaling, distinguishing the theme from androgen receptor and mammary development neighbours.

name: Scavenger receptor uptake of lipoproteins and immune complexes
rationale: Members are scavenger receptor classes A, B, F and H plus immune complex clearance, protein import and cholesterol storage; neighbours instead concern apoptotic cell clearance, hyaluronan degradation or iron/heme uptake.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and its congenital muscular dystrophies
rationale: All members are DAG1 core M1-M3 O-mannosyl glycan synthesis or POMT1/POMT2/POMGNT1 defects causing dystroglycanopathy, distinguishing it from dystrophin complex/basement membrane and dolichol-mannose CDG neighbours.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and inhibitor resistance
name: KIT and PDGFR oncogenic mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Every member is signaling by or drug resistance of KIT or PDGFR mutants, whereas neighbours concern FGFR, ALK and FLT3 mutants.

name: Urogenital smooth muscle function in reproduction and micturition
rationale: Members concern smooth-muscle-driven urogenital functions (uterine contraction, parturition, erection, insemination, mating, micturition, peristalsis), distinguishing them from tachykinin signaling, general smooth muscle relaxation and gastrointestinal motility neighbours.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and lung mesenchyme proliferation
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal signaling with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation, and the lung-associated mesenchyme members distinguish it from prostate, pancreatic/kidney and lung epithelial branching neighbours.

core: Ubiquitin chain assembly in protein quality control
qualifier: atypical K6, K11, K27, K29 and branched linkages
name: Atypical ubiquitin chain linkages in protein quality control
rationale: Members are non-K48/K63 and branched polyubiquitination, E3 ligase and Josephin DUB activity tied to misfolded-protein quality control and ERAD, distinguishing the theme from proteasome, other DUB families and ERAD-inhibition neighbours.

qualifier: canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog including cancer mutants
name: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog transduction including cancer mutants
rationale: Members are beta-catenin destruction complex, Notch intracellular domain and GLI/SMO signaling with their oncogenic mutants and regulated intramembrane proteolysis, distinguishing the theme from planar polarity, Hippo, Wnt secretion and Hedgehog ligand processing neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are successive acyl-CoA chain-shortening steps of mitochondrial beta-oxidation and ketone body synthesis/utilization, distinguishing them from carnitine shuttle and branched-chain amino acid catabolism neighbours.

name: Pharmacokinetics of aspirin, statins, fluoroquinolones and corticosteroids
rationale: All four members are absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion of specific therapeutic drugs, distinguishing them from general xenobiotic metabolism, transporter and paracetamol/conjugation neighbours.

qualifier: synthesis, uptake and secretion with histamine receptors
name: Serotonin synthesis and transport with histamine signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin biosynthesis, uptake and secretion plus histamine metabolism and receptor signaling, distinguishing the theme from monoamine oxidase/catecholamine catabolism and serotonin receptor signaling neighbours.

name: Vascular smooth muscle development and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members combine vascular smooth muscle differentiation and matrix adhesion with endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear and perivascular/endothelial modules, distinguishing them from SRF cytoskeletal, smooth muscle phenotypic switching and eNOS trafficking neighbours.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans and glycosphingolipids with storage diseases
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage diseases
rationale: All members concern lysosomal degradation of GAGs and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses/GM2 gangliosidoses caused by its defects, distinguishing the theme from GAG biosynthesis and sialic acid/nucleotide sugar neighbours.

core: Viral life cycle in the host cell
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members cover entry, protein processing and assembly of coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, distinguishing them from host antiviral restriction and SARS-CoV-1 PDZ-targeting neighbours.

qualifier: very-long-chain substrates and spastic paraplegia/leukodystrophy defects
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation and spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase-driven peroxisomal oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids and its defects (ALD, SPG5A, SPG42, SPG56), distinguishing them from peroxisome import/biogenesis and alpha-oxidation neighbours.

name: Synapse assembly by receptor tyrosine phosphatase and SALM adhesion
rationale: Members concern synaptic membrane adhesion organizing pre- and postsynaptic assembly, with receptor-type PTPs and SALMs distinguishing it from neurexin-neuroligin and NMDA receptor clustering neighbours.

name: Erythroid heme biosynthesis, iron homeostasis and gas transport
rationale: Members span heme biosynthesis, transferrin/iron uptake and its disorders, erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and Rh ammonium transport, distinguishing the theme from other metal-ion and oxidative stress neighbours.

name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake
rationale: Members concern synthesis, vesicular loading, toxin-sensitive release, reuptake and degradation of monoamines, GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine, distinguishing them from dopamine receptor signaling/behavior and cholinergic neuromuscular neighbours.

name: Phosphatidylserine-mediated apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment
rationale: All four members are steps of efferocytosis (PS exposure, recognition, engulfment, neutrophil clearance), distinguishing them from microglial activation and scavenger receptor neighbours.

core: Metabolic hormone G protein-coupled receptor signaling
name: Nutrient-sensing and glucagon-family hormone GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCRs for free fatty acids, hydroxycarboxylic acids, glucagon-family peptides, somatostatin, relaxin and ghrelin with nutrient and hormone secretion responses, distinguishing them from feeding behavior/leptin and calcitonin/amylin receptor neighbours.

name: MECP2-mediated neuronal gene regulation and its Rett mutations
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation and target programmes, its loss-of-function variants, HDAC deacetylation, NPAS4 and memory, distinguishing the theme from CREB/cAMP signaling and behavioral neighbours.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I/III, rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: Nuclear rRNA, snRNA and pre-mRNA transcription and processing
rationale: Members span Pol I/III transcription, rRNA processing, snRNP assembly, splicing, histone mRNA processing and nuclear RNA decay, distinguishing them from mRNA export, RNA modification and translation initiation neighbours.

qualifier: oocyte provisioning and maternal mRNA clearance
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and oocyte maternal provisioning
rationale: Members are oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and zygotic epigenetic reprogramming, distinguishing the theme from piRNA/spermatogenesis germline and deadenylation-regulation neighbours.
